If a booking is older than 24 hours and currently ineligible only because it is not a business flight, the agent may offer to upgrade the cabin to business class; once upgraded to business class, the reservation becomes eligible for cancellation.

The API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!
